boxes.title: Railways & telegraph: added
items: First train: **14** coaches, ==**three** steam locomotives==; **Great Indian Peninsula Railway**
Other first lines: **Howrah-Hooghly** (east), **Delhi-Agra** (north)
South line by **Madras Railway Company**; Andhra: ==**nine** lines **1871-1900**==
Telegraph trunk: Calcutta, **Peshawar**, Bombay, Madras by mid-1850s
Railways also moved grain for **famine relief**

boxes.title: Press laws: added
items: **Registration Act 1867** (Lawrence); ==**Sec. 124A** sedition **1870**== (Mayo)
VPA: exemption only by **proofs to a censor**; target also **Samachar**
Ripon's repeal: pre-censorship dropped, **press commissioner**
**Besant**: Commonweal, New India deposits **Rs 2,000** → **Rs 10,000** (1916-17)
1882 → about **25** years of relative freedom; Hastings left India **1785**

boxes.title: Macaulay & Munro
items: Minute **2 February 1835**; President, General Committee of Public Instruction
Aim: =="Indian in blood and colour, but English in taste"==
**Munro's Survey of Indigenous Education (1826)**: wide village-school network
Munro's schools (**2** Kadapa, **1** Nellore, **2** Vizag) closed **1836**
Wood's Despatch rejected downward filtration (mass instruction)

boxes.title: Current
items: RNI = **Press Registrar General**; 1867 Act repealed **1 March 2024**
Press Freedom Index 2026: ==**157th of 180**==; The Hindu **147** years (**S. Abdul Nazeer**)
**Press Council Act 1978**: no punitive powers; **Atmiya Sabha 1814** (⚠ 1815)
